sentences.text: Barclays is extending its use of Claude to accelerate software development and modernise legacy systems, with an enterprise-wide roll-out planned for its engineers.
Sony Bank is applying generative AI at full scale in developing its core banking system, which makes AI-assisted engineering a theme this week.
Agentic AI is live at LHV Bank, which has deployed it for customer emails.
On the customer side, Emirates NBD has launched a bank-led AI travel assistant, while NatWest has unveiled generative AI tools for banking support.
In risk, MVB Bank is using AI to strengthen vendor risk management.
